hooks.name: aidlc-discovery-join-check
hooks.description: When a role's state changes, reminds the orchestrator to run the deterministic join-barrier checker before consolidating open questions.

action.prompt:
If a role's state just changed to 'complete', run the join-barrier checker before proceeding:
1. Run: node .kiro/aidlc-common/scripts/process-checker.js Product-Definition/state/session-index.md
2. If 'join' is 'ready', run the open-questions (join) skill to consolidate and flag contradictions.
3. Otherwise, continue the in-progress role. Do not run the join until both roles are complete.
